legalResearch.title: Kazakhstan Digital Code No.255-VIII (EDS/e-doc provisions)
legalResearch.interpretation: Verify effective version, signature method, legal entity authority before treating quote/POD as legally binding. This document does not assert that portal click is EDS.

legalResearch.title: Prior electronic document and EDS law
legalResearch.interpretation: Reported repealed; avoid outdated law as operating requirement.

decisionStateDefinitions.DESIGN_SPECIFIED: Suggested fail-safe technical/operational rule is written, not approved by party representatives
decisionStateDefinitions.PENDING_REAL_STAKEHOLDER: Real stakeholder must approve obligations and exceptions
decisionStateDefinitions.NOT_EXECUTED: No production code/tests or simulator executed

decisions.title: Customer legal signatory on Quote
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Customer quote acceptance requires verified identity, org representation/delegation evidence, exact immutable QuoteVersion digest, full terms, authority valid at event time; separate signatory grant; if verified signing method unavailable: status SIGNATURE_PENDING not ACCEPTED and no binding booking.
decisions.requiredEvidence: Signed/accepted record: signer identity, tenant/customerOrg, delegation proof ref, signature method, UTC timestamp, termsHash, version, policyVersion.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Signing method and Kazakhstan pilot contract wording require written legal signoff; portal click alone not assumed equivalent to statutory EDS.

decisions.title: External customer Quote decline
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: customer:quote:decline requires explicit customer decline permission (not read), current ISSUED version, exact customer-account relationship and reason. Decline is an authorized state-changing command, idempotent and audited; cannot decline ACCEPTED/EXPIRED/SUPERSEDED version.
decisions.requiredEvidence: quoteVersion, actor, reasonCode, idempotencyKey, expectedVersion, timestamp, event id.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Business must decide whether general customer requester can decline or only signatory; default separate grant.

decisions.title: Own-tenant customer vs provider EXC identity
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Each request resolves verified subject, active relationship and providerTenant/customerOrg/account; no caller-supplied tenant override; own Tenant-B membership never creates membership in provider Tenant-A; RLS and field projections deny cross-customer and cross-provider reads.
decisions.requiredEvidence: grantId, providerTenantId, customerOrgId, customerAccountId, scope, expiry, revocation, policy version.
scenarioVariants: partner Grant revoked while Redis warm
decisions.outstandingSignoff: CustomerAccount ownership, verified company contact, invite origin and authority require customer pilot signoff.

decisions.title: Subscription suspended with active cargo
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: SaaS subscription restrictions never delete, hide or silently stop in-flight safety-critical trip/custody/POD/evidence and incident reporting. Proposed SAFE_CONTINUITY mode permits scoped safety/evidence commands on already active work, blocks new discretionary paid bookings; immutable ledger and audit. Never treat billing fault as transport cancellation.
decisions.requiredEvidence: subscription state, active booking/trip refs, continuity policy version, authorized actors, audit, exact allowed actions.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Scope/duration of safe continuity, contractual commitments and retention need legal/operations/SaaS signoff; no default automatic operation without policy.

decisions.title: Material change to RFQ/Quote after issue or acceptance
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Material edit of cargo/address/date/quantity/price creates explicit revision with snapshot and change proposal, never mutates issued/accepted QuoteVersion. Pre-accept: supersede old version and require new approval; post-accept: amendment request, commercial and customer agreement, Booking revalidation/re-reservation if capacity impacted. Until acceptance keep current binding truth and explicit pending change; no phantom cancellation.
decisions.requiredEvidence: old/new immutable version refs, change reason, expectedVersion, approval/acceptance hashes, reservation impact.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Which changes are material, cancellation price and legal amendment process require customer/Sales/legal signoff.

decisions.title: CarrierOffer selection/withdrawal and binding capacity
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: CarrierOffer REQUESTED/OFFERED/SELECTED is sourcing state, never resource availability proof. Carrier may decline/withdraw before specifically defined cutoff; store carrier-authorized acknowledgement with expiry/version. Fleet holds resource and obtains separate owner consent; only CONFIRMED capacity may unblock Booking. Post-confirm withdrawal triggers BookingException/replacement, not silent resource release or false confirmation.
decisions.requiredEvidence: carrierOffer version, actor authority, supplier agreement, ack timestamp, expiry, capacity reservation ref, exception event.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Carrier commitments, contract signature method, cancellation liabilities and fallback manual evidence require carrier/legal signoff.

decisions.title: Double-booking exclusion and expiry race
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: PostgreSQL is authority for exclusive vehicle/driver/trailer per overlapping time interval; unique/exclusion constraints or explicit locked resource-interval model; version checks and transactional hold+outbox. HELD expiry job can RELEASE only same version and expired state; CONFIRMED or CONSUMED never released by stale expiry. No Redis-only booking lock.
decisions.requiredEvidence: resource ids, tenant/owner, UTC tstzrange interval, reservation version, holdExpiresAt, commit event.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Shared load and partial vehicle capacity not supported in R0 unless separately qualified; vehicle/driver/trailer resource model to be signed by Fleet.

decisions.title: Compliance critical UNKNOWN and legal route safety
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Critical missing/unverified permit, cargo restriction, jurisdictional route constraint or UNKNOWN assessment yields HOLD/DENY, never default allow. Only qualified Compliance authority and versioned rule/evidence can resolve; not Dispatcher/ML/ETA. Keep manual review in pilot; no general-purpose rules engine.
decisions.requiredEvidence: source rule version, validity/jurisdiction, cargo/route snapshot, reviewer identity/qualification, decision and evidence refs.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Kazakhstan corridor applicability, binding norm version and legally qualified reviewer must be validated against official sources and counsel.

decisions.title: Offline pickup event after reassignment/revoke
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Separate capture of historical fact from authority to mutate current custody. Offline event with stable event ID, signed device/actor assignment snapshot, observedAt/receivedAt, baseVersion, cargo units and evidence; on late replay verify authoritative assignment history and monotonic custody. Valid historical evidence may be quarantined for reconciliation; revoked/current unauthorized actor cannot create new custody state. Exactly one logical effect via DB dedup.
decisions.requiredEvidence: eventId, actor, trip/assignmentVersion, cargoUnitIds, evidence hash, observedAt, receivedAt, signature, decision/reconciliation.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Legal admissibility of offline signature and custody handover proof needs operations/legal signoff.

decisions.title: Partial POD and conservation
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Each identified CargoUnit has nonnegative conserved quantity across current custodian, accepted delivered, returned and incident disposition. DeliveryAttempt 8/10=PARTIAL, Shipment not DELIVERED; residual 2 remain owned by known custodian with reattempt/return case. POD evidence append-only and corrections versioned; duplicate signature/event does not create second delivery.
decisions.requiredEvidence: cargoUnit IDs, accepted/refused/damaged counts, custody actor, verified receiver, signed POD, evidence hash, disposition refs.
scenarioVariants: full, partial, no-show, reject, damaged, return, mixed units, duplicate callback, delivery correction.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Recipient authority and jurisdiction-specific evidence form need consignee/legal review.

decisions.title: Booking cancellation and financial impact
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Customer submits CancellationRequest, does not mutate Booking. Booking owner checks exact aggregate state+version, started Trip, custody and contractual terms. Before execution may CANCEL after policy approval with reservation release, invoice/charges audit; in execution must record exception/return/rescue with custody and payment impact, not direct CANCELLED. Nonapproved fees stay disputed/pending.
decisions.requiredEvidence: cancelRequest id, booking version, legal terms snapshot, reason, actor, time, carrier response, approved charges, resource release/compensation event.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Precise time windows, fee thresholds, party liable and cancellation authority require forwarder/customer/carrier/finance/legal agreement.

decisions.title: Payment approval vs bank/ERP settlement
decisions.recommendedFailSafeContract: Payment PREPARED/APPROVED are internal authorization not actual settlement. Only verified bank/ERP transaction and unique allocation(s), currency/amount/FX/taxes, matched legal entity/source may reduce receivable/payable. Duplicate callbacks/idempotency never create second allocation; reconcile partial advances, disputes and credit corrections separately. Paid status derived from confirmed allocation not UI command.
decisions.requiredEvidence: paymentTransaction reference, source/issuer, hash, amount/currency, exchange snapshot, allocation unique key, approver and initiator IDs.
decisions.outstandingSignoff: Which bank/ERP is authoritative, ledger of record, legal payment evidence, timing/reversal policy need finance/accounting signoff.
